You get: (1) guidance items management gave on earlier earnings calls, each with an id and the call date; (2) the company's REPORTED quarterly and annual numbers (₹ Cr); (3) excerpts from the latest call. Use ONLY this data — no outside knowledge, no news. Tasks:

B) credibility: one sentence overall read on promise vs delivery.
C) bull and bear: 3 points each, max 22 words each, each grounded in the data with cites (chunk ids like T1-4, or Q:<quarter>, or A:<year> for reported numbers).
